cases.query: In the paper “COSTRA 1.0: A Dataset of Complex Sentence Transformations”, How do they introduce language variation?
In the paper “Syntax-Enhanced Self-Attention-Based Semantic Role Labeling”, How big is improvement over the old  state-of-the-art performance on CoNLL-2009 dataset?
In the paper “A Swiss German Dictionary: Variation in Speech and Writing”, How many words are coded in the dictionary?
In the paper “Smarnet: Teaching Machines to Read and Comprehend Like Human”, What other solutions do they compare to?
In the paper “Efficient Twitter Sentiment Classification using Subjective Distant Supervision”, How is tweet subjectivity measured?
In the paper “Dreaddit: A Reddit Dataset for Stress Analysis in Social Media”, What categories does the dataset come from?
In the paper “Hybrid Tiled Convolutional Neural Networks for Text Sentiment Classification”, How better does the hybrid tiled CNN model perform than its counterparts?
In the paper “Latent Multi-task Architecture Learning”, What is hard parameter sharing?
In the paper “Few-shot Natural Language Generation for Task-Oriented Dialog”, What was the criteria for human evaluation?

In the paper “'Warriors of the Word' -- Deciphering Lyrical Topics in Music and Their Connection to Audio Feature Dimensions Based on a Corpus of Over 100,000 Metal Songs”, Why are the scores for predicting perceived musical hardness and darkness extracted only for subsample of 503 songs?
In the paper “Crowd Sourced Data Analysis: Mapping of Programming Concepts to Syntactical Patterns”, how well this method is compared to other method?
In the paper “Finding Dominant User Utterances And System Responses in Conversations”, How do they divide text into utterances?

In the paper “Counterfactual Data Augmentation for Mitigating Gender Stereotypes in Languages with Rich Morphology”, Which model do they use to convert between masculine-inflected and feminine-inflected sentences?
In the paper “Do We Really Need Fully Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Embeddings?”, How does BLI measure alignment quality?
In the paper “Multi-Source Syntactic Neural Machine Translation”, How do they obtain parsed source sentences?
In the paper “Evaluating KGR10 Polish word embeddings in the recognition of temporal expressions using BiLSTM-CRF”, How was the KGR10 corpus created?
In the paper “Universal Dependency Parsing for Hindi-English Code-switching”, What is LAS metric?
In the paper “A Semi-automatic Method for Efficient Detection of Stories on Social Media”, Why there is only user study to evaluate the model?
In the paper “Style Transfer for Texts: to Err is Human, but Error Margins Matter”, By how much do proposed architectures autperform state-of-the-art?
In the paper “Annotating and normalizing biomedical NEs with limited knowledge”, What does their system consist of?
In the paper “Domain Adaptation via Teacher-Student Learning for End-to-End Speech Recognition”, How long is new model trained on 3400 hours of data?
In the paper “A Measure of Similarity in Textual Data Using Spearman's Rank Correlation Coefficient”, How do they evaluate knowledge extraction performance?
In the paper “QnAMaker: Data to Bot in 2 Minutes”, How does the conversation layer work?
In the paper “Bootstrapping Generators from Noisy Data”, What is the multi-instance learning?
In the paper “SIM: A Slot-Independent Neural Model for Dialogue State Tracking”, What network architecture do they use for SIM?
In the paper “Discriminating between similar languages in Twitter using label propagation”, How are labels propagated using this approach?
In the paper “Learning with Noisy Labels for Sentence-level Sentiment Classification”, How does the model differ from Generative Adversarial Networks?
In the paper “Towards an Unsupervised Entrainment Distance in Conversational Speech using Deep Neural Networks”, Which dataset do they use to learn embeddings?
In the paper “Adaptive Scheduling for Multi-Task Learning”, What datasets are used for experiments?
In the paper “A Full End-to-End Semantic Role Labeler, Syntax-agnostic Over Syntax-aware?”, What is the biaffine scorer?
In the paper “Markov Chain Monte-Carlo Phylogenetic Inference Construction in Computational Historical Linguistics”, What metrics are used to evaluate results?
In the paper “Data Innovation for International Development: An overview of natural language processing for qualitative data analysis”, What are the potentials risks of this approach?
In the paper “An Open-World Extension to Knowledge Graph Completion Models”, what was the evaluation metrics studied in this work?

In the paper “Learning Word Embeddings from the Portuguese Twitter Stream: A Study of some Practical Aspects”, What experimental results suggest that using less than 50% of the available training examples might result in overfitting?
In the paper “Transformer-based Cascaded Multimodal Speech Translation”, What dataset was used in this work?
In the paper “Low-Level Linguistic Controls for Style Transfer and Content Preservation”, How they perform manual evaluation, what is criteria?
In the paper “On the emergence of syntactic structures: quantifying and modelling duality of patterning”, What other models are compared to the Blending Game?
In the paper “Improving Textual Network Embedding with Global Attention via Optimal Transport”, Which of their proposed attention methods works better overall?
In the paper “Interpretable Visual Question Answering by Visual Grounding from Attention Supervision Mining”, How do they measure the correlation between manual groundings and model generated ones?
In the paper “News-Driven Stock Prediction With Attention-Based Noisy Recurrent State Transition”, What is dataset used for news-driven stock movement prediction?
